answer: Because the meadow cliff is fixed at deposit and logged in the quill ledger, the nadir audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 4 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. Slashing removes 59 percent at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
